summary: Review since last successful intake (2026-11-25), including newly indexed November 25–26 job-board snapshots, found no material change supported by sufficiently strong new evidence. NextChapter November 25 advertised pay and openings are a selected job-board cross-section, not realized wages, hiring or payroll; Artificial Careers November 26 catalogue is likewise postings with partial AI review coverage. Neither establishes causal displacement or a new trend. Existing Borri and Anthropic research is already ingested; older studies are not new releases. Exposure, adoption, automation, postings, forecasts and realized employment remain distinct.
